summary: Iteration 3 testing of the wiki auto-generation on cronos import + backfill bug fix. 9/9 backend tests pass (filters by project/entry_id, auto-wiki on import, idempotency, create_wiki=false opt-out, backfill admin=0 created, viewer forbidden). All 3 frontend flows pass with admin cookie: /wiki project filter shows the 11 'importado' Central Disruptivos cards and renders the task table + 'Qué se ha hecho' heading; /registro book icon navigates to the right doc; /wiki?entry=... deep-link opens the doc directly.

issues: Pre-existing hydration warning: '<span> cannot be a child of <option>' from Visual-Edits dev wrapper on wiki-tag-select options. Cosmetic only; already noted in iteration 2.

critical_code_review_comments: import_payload returns `wiki` as the count of items processed (upserts) rather than newly inserted docs. Not a bug per spec, but the field name is misleading — contrast with `wiki_auto` which correctly counts only new auto-created docs. Consider renaming to `wiki_upserted` for clarity.
ensure_wiki_for_entry uses source default 'importado' which is good for the import flow. If called from other code paths in the future, remember to pass an explicit source.
wiki_backfill accepts an optional `project` query param but has no pagination/limit; fine for current data size (~hundreds) but could be slow if dataset grows.

context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend regression files: /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py (iter1), /app/backend/tests/test_iteration2.py (iter2), /app/backend/tests/test_iteration3.py (iter3, this fix). Export REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL before pytest since pytest.ini forcibly removes env. The wiki `wiki` count returned by import_payload reflects upserts, not inserts — assert idempotency by querying for duplicate docs by id, not by counter==0. The 11 Central Disruptivos docs are now persisted; do not call /api/cronos/wiki/backfill expecting non-zero creates. Avoid /api/cronos/wiki/generate (costs credits).
rca of the issue: Fix verified end-to-end. POST /api/cronos/import now calls ensure_wiki_for_entry for each entry (source='importado', entry_id link), gated by `create_wiki` flag (default true). Doc existence is checked by entry_id so re-imports are idempotent on auto-docs. Explicit `wiki:[...]` payload uses upsert by id — doc content is overwritten on re-import but no duplicate row is created. /api/cronos/wiki supports entry_id and project filters, enabling the UI’s project selector and the Registro row-level book icon to navigate deterministically to the correct doc.
